description: This file contains unit tests for the AVInput plugin component, using Google Test framework. It tests various methods and behaviors of the AVInput plugin, including method existence, content protection status, number of inputs, current video mode, and support for EDID2 Allm features. The tests mock the HdmiInput interface to simulate hardware interactions.

classes.description: A test fixture for AVInput plugin, initializing the plugin, JSONRPC handler, and connection.
